description:
## Problem
The 2026-11-25 rewrite inventory found translator logic in BenchBox that the text-rewrite scanner (tests/unit/sql_compat/test_core_sql_text_rewrite.py) cannot see. PR #4537 moved the 22 registered rewrites and the 11 scanned text rewrites to the fork, but these remain on develop (locations at 8d8723e0):
- benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py `_install_select_transforms` (:19), `_keep_full_outer_join` (:44), `_eliminate_starrocks_qualify` (:55): replace TRANSFORMS on the vendored Doris, SingleStore and StarRocks generators at runtime. PR #4537 added eliminate_window_clause there.
- `_starrocks_order_by_projection_aliases` (called at dialect_utils.py:515): re-parses generated StarRocks SQL after generation.
- benchbox/utils/questdb_subqueries.py (613 lines, `rewrite_subqueries` :593): a local AST rewriter for QuestDB that may partly duplicate the fork QuestDB generator lowering. It also holds `_case_flag_to_predicate`, which was kept on 2026-11-25 because the fork output still differs.
- benchbox/core/transactional/benchmark_base.py `_starrocks_cleanup_statement` (:33) and `questdb_cleanup_statements`, and benchbox.platforms.questdb_rewrites.rewrite_query: regex cleanups on SQL text.
Owner direction (2026-11-20): compatibility logic belongs in the fork, versioned and tested with the transpiler.

## Change
Inventory each piece (callers, tests, output it produces), classify it (fork carried patch, fork named rewrite, delete as duplicate of fork behaviour, or exception with reason), land fork changes and deliver a wheel, then delete the BenchBox copies in one cutover PR, extending the scanner so these patterns are caught in future.

## Decision gates
- G1: the owner confirms the exception list (pieces that cannot move) before code moves, as for sqlglot-rewrites-into-fork.
- G2: any output change found by the byte-identity comparison is shown to the owner for approval before the cutover merges.
- G3: QuestDB `_case_flag_to_predicate` is removed only if the adopted wheel produces identical QuestDB SQL without it (rule from questdb-case-prepass-upstream-9193-followup-20261119).

## Verification rubric
Pass only if: inventory and confirmed exceptions are in context; for every moved piece, recorded translate_sql_query outputs for TPC-H, TPC-DS and TPC-Havoc on doris, starrocks, singlestore and questdb are byte-identical before and after (or differences owner-approved); the scanner flags a reintroduced runtime TRANSFORMS edit or post-generation regex in a test; only approved exceptions remain locally.

## Guardrails
- Fork changes follow downstream/MAINTAINING.md (carried vs original files, patches.json, version bump per merged change) and the fork review process; never hand-edit benchbox/_vendor; adopt through make sqlglot-adopt-wheel.
- No text replacement or per-platform SQL added in benchbox/core.
- Heavy work through lock-taking entry points; no live cloud.
- Write work: linked worktrees, pinned human identity, no agent attribution, changelog fragment, make pr-preflight, make pr-open, make pr-arm.
